scoring_justification: Paper reports Cp only graphically (Fig. 1), not as tabulated values. While CΩ, αp, BT are tabulated, Ω(T) is only in a figure, so exact numerical Cp comparison is infeasible. Structural trend verification (monotonicity for Al, V-shaped non-monotonicity for Rb) is the strongest feasible tier.

outputs.description: Specific heat at constant pressure as a function of normalized temperature for supercooled metallic liquids. The hidden verifier will inspect structural properties of the Cp data for each metal; exact trend criteria are not disclosed.

output_contract.notes: Structural trends are checked with small tolerance intervals as documented in the hidden checker.

steps.description: For Al: verify Cp_kB values are monotonically non-decreasing as T_Tm decreases (supercooled direction), with a meaningful overall increase from high to low T.

For Rb: verify Cp_kB first decreases from Tm region to a minimum near T_Tm≈0.65, then rises approaching the Tg region. Check minimum location, decreasing left side, increasing right side, and that both high-T and low-T Cp exceed the minimum.
